  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Binary file detection runs only for "extra" (pass-2) files; copy() is called with extra=False by default for legacy-eligible files.
  WHY: Legacy-eligible files (e.g. in src/, scripts/) are not checked for NUL bytes, so binary files end up in the snapshot, which violates the documented exclusion requirements. The root cause looks the same as the 216-221 finding, but the cited lines do not overlap, so this is kept separate.
- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:155-157,256-263 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The all-text pass 2 sends credential-shaped tracked files (id_rsa, id_ed25519, .npmrc, .pypirc, .netrc, .git-credentials, *.jks) through `copy(path, extra=True)`, because `sensitive()` only rejects bad_parts directories, names starting with .env, and the .pem/.key/.p12/.pfx/.keystore suffixes.
  WHY: Credential contents reach the read-only /source snapshot that the clarify agent and its model can read; legacy mode never copied these files. openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave no severity.
- tests/test_clarify_isolated_run.py:test_default_all_text_snapshot_lists_exclusions,test_nothing_excluded_mounts_original_prompt,test_kill_switch_restores_legacy_filter,test_legacy_files_keep_budget_priority,test_unsafe_names_are_counted_but_not_listed,test_agent_instruction_omission_applies_to_all_text(_files) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate on the PR head reports all six runtime tests in the new file as failing, and none of them has ever passed.
  WHY: The all-text snapshot is on by default (CLARIFY_SNAPSHOT_ALL_TEXT_ENABLED default true at scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:93) and has no passing test, and static reading does not reveal the cause. Both reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:213-219 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In pass 2, each file up to 2 MiB is read in full (`data = source.read(max_file_bytes + 1)`) before the 8 KiB NUL check, and files rejected as binary are never added to `total`.
  WHY: The 64 MiB limit does not bound reads of rejected binaries, so a repo with thousands of tracked binary assets incurs gigabytes of I/O on every clarify/plan/triage/unblock-judge run. Rated NIT.
